_comment: Rename this file to orgs.json and fill in your credentials. NEVER commit orgs.json to version control.

my_org._comment: Option A: pre-generated bearer token (simplest for dev/testing — no auto-refresh)

client_a_dev._comment: Option B: OAuth Server-to-Server (auto-refreshes; recommended). Get credentials from Adobe Developer Console → Project → OAuth Server-to-Server.
client_a_dev._comment_sandboxes: Named sandbox aliases — lets you call switch_sandbox('dev') or switch_sandbox('prod') by short name.
client_a_dev._comment_namespaces: Primary identity namespace per sandbox. 'primary' is the namespace code, 'primary_id' is its integer ID (find it via list_identity_namespaces). 'xdm_identity_map_key' is the key used in XDM identityMap — usually matches 'primary'.
client_a_dev._comment_merge_policies: Merge policy IDs per sandbox. Find these via list_merge_policies. 'primary' is used by default; 'secondary' is optional for edge/streaming contexts.
